detectors.label: Runtime and UI baseline
detectors.note: Console, request, image, layout, focus, and rendered-state observations.
detectors.noteZh: 观察控制台、请求、图片、布局、焦点与渲染状态。

detectors.label: Responsive viewport matrix
detectors.note: Each configured viewport runs in a fresh browser context.
detectors.noteZh: 每个配置视口都在新的浏览器上下文中运行。

detectors.label: Deep recovery and accessibility scenarios
detectors.labelZh: 深度恢复与无障碍场景
detectors.note: Preference, degraded API, empty data, and axe-core scenarios run only in deep mode.
detectors.noteZh: 偏好设置、API 降级、空数据与 axe-core 场景仅在 deep 模式运行。

detectors.label: Declarative product requirements
detectors.note: Validated selectors and assertions run without arbitrary project code.
detectors.noteZh: 经校验的选择器与断言不会执行任意项目代码。

detectors.label: Safe user journeys
detectors.note: Same-origin declarative steps must include proof and cannot submit forms.
detectors.noteZh: 同源声明式步骤必须包含证明，并且不能提交表单。

detectors.label: Performance budgets
detectors.note: Browser performance metrics are compared with explicit numeric limits.
detectors.noteZh: 将浏览器性能指标与明确的数值上限比较。

detectors.label: Network reliability budgets
detectors.note: Counts and timings are retained; response bodies and query values are not.
detectors.noteZh: 保留计数与耗时，不保留响应正文与查询参数值。

detectors.label: Same-origin link integrity
detectors.note: A bounded number of allowed same-origin links are checked with HEAD only.
detectors.noteZh: 仅使用 HEAD 核查有限数量且在允许范围内的同源链接。

detectors.label: Publishing metadata
detectors.note: Presence, length, count, and directive facts are retained without copying page text.
detectors.noteZh: 仅保留存在性、长度、数量与指令事实，不复制页面正文。

detectors.label: Reviewed visual baseline
detectors.note: Baselines can change only through a separate explicit approval command.
detectors.noteZh: 视觉基线只能通过独立的显式批准命令变更。

detectors.label: Response and origin security
detectors.note: Headers, mixed content, forms, and origin counts are inspected without submission.
detectors.noteZh: 在不提交数据的前提下检查响应头、混合内容、表单与来源数量。

detectors.label: Aggregate browser-storage privacy
detectors.note: Only aggregate cookie and Web Storage counts and bytes are retained.
detectors.noteZh: 仅保留 Cookie 与 Web Storage 的聚合数量和字节数。

safety.en: This command did not open a browser, request the target, or modify application code.
safety.zh: 此命令没有打开浏览器、请求目标网站或修改应用代码。

safety.en: Navigation and declarative journeys remain same-origin and bounded by the route policy.
safety.zh: 导航与声明式旅程保持同源，并受路由策略限制。

safety.en: RealityCheck does not submit forms, purchase, delete, sign out, or approve releases.
safety.zh: RealityCheck 不会提交表单、购买、删除、退出登录或批准发布。

safety.en: Repair suggestions and copyable tasks require human review; no fix is applied from this plan.
safety.zh: 修复建议与可复制任务需要人工复核；此计划不会应用任何修复。

retention.en: Audit screenshots and bounded DOM measurements may be written as evidence.
retention.zh: 核查截图与有限 DOM 测量值可能写入证据。

retention.en: Response bodies and URL query values are not retained.
retention.zh: 不保留响应正文与 URL 查询参数值。

retention.en: Cookie names, values, storage keys, and storage values are not retained.
retention.zh: 不保留 Cookie 名称和值，也不保留存储键和值。

retention.en: Authentication storage-state paths and values are not copied into the plan or report.
retention.zh: 认证状态文件路径和值不会复制到计划或报告中。

retention.en: Private signing keys and credentials remain outside generated evidence.
retention.zh: 私有签名密钥与凭据始终位于生成证据之外。

warnings: This is an execution preview, not evidence that the target passed or failed.
这是执行预览，不是目标通过或失败的证据。
The maximum scenario count is conservative; crawl discovery may find fewer than 20 page(s).
最大场景数按保守上限计算；实际爬取可能少于 20 个页面。
